annotations.title: Submit a USDT payment for an order

description: After sending USDT TRC-20 for an order, pass the order_id and the Tron transaction hash. The service finds the transfer on-chain, checks recipient and exact amount and, once confirmed (~1 minute), issues or extends the API key. Returns a verdict: paid, unconfirmed, wrong_amount, wrong_recipient or not_found.

lang.description: Language of texts in the result. Default: Russian unless the client prefers English.
